audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Eden/Ezekiel river-tree imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for river, tree of life, no curse, seeing face, final witness, invitation, warning, grace.

verses.restored: And he showed me river of water of life, bright as crystal, going out from throne of Divine and of Lamb.

familiar.text: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

modern.text: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

original.text: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ⸀ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον, ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου

verses.restored: In midst of its street and on either side of river, tree of life making twelve fruits, giving its fruit according to each month, and leaves of tree are for healing of nations.

familiar.text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

modern.text: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

original.text: ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς· καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα, κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ⸀ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν.

verses.restored: And every curse will no longer be; throne of Divine and Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve/worship him.

familiar.text: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

modern.text: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.

original.text: καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι. καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται, καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ,

verses.restored: They will see his face, and his name will be upon their foreheads.

familiar.text: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.

modern.text: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.

original.text: καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: Night will be no more, and they have no need of lamp-light or sun-light, because Lord Divine will shine upon them, and they will reign into ages of ages.

familiar.text: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

modern.text: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever. Jesus Is Coming

original.text: καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ⸀ἔτι, καὶ ⸂οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν⸃ ⸀φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ ⸀φῶς ἡλίου, ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς φωτίσει ⸀ἐπʼ αὐτούς, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

verses.restored: He said to me: These words are trustworthy and true, and Lord, the Divine of spirits of prophets, sent his messenger to show his servants what must happen in swiftness.

familiar.text: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

modern.text: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”

original.text: Καὶ ⸀εἶπέν μοι· Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί, καὶ ⸀ὁ κύριος, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει·

verses.restored: And look, I come quickly. Blessed is the one keeping words of prophecy of this scroll.

familiar.text: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

modern.text: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book. ”

original.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ· μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου.

verses.restored: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things; and when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before feet of messenger showing me these things.

familiar.text: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

modern.text: And I am John, who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

original.text: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα. καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα, ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα.

verses.restored: And he says to me: Do not do that. I am fellow servant with you and your siblings the prophets and those keeping words of this scroll. Worship the Divine.

familiar.text: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.

modern.text: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”

original.text: καὶ λέγει μοι· Ὅρα μή· σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· τῷ θεῷ προσκύνησον.

verses.restored: And he says to me: Do not seal words of prophecy of this scroll, for the season is near.

familiar.text: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

modern.text: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.

original.text: Καὶ λέγει μοι· Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου, ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν.

verses.restored: Let the one doing injustice still do injustice, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous/just still do righteousness/justice, and the holy still be holy.

familiar.text: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

modern.text: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”

original.text: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ⸀ῥυπαρευθήτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι.

verses.restored: Look, I come quickly, and my wage/reward is with me, to repay each as one's work is.

familiar.text: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

modern.text: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.

original.text: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ, καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ⸀ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: I am Alpha and Omega, first and last, beginning and completion.

familiar.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

modern.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”

original.text: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ⸀ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ ⸀τὸ τέλος.

verses.restored: Blessed are those washing their robes, so that their authority will be upon tree of life and they may enter gates into city.

familiar.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

modern.text: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.

original.text: Μακάριοι οἱ ⸂πλύνοντες τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν⸃, ἵνα ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν.

verses.restored: Outside are dogs and sorcerers and sexually misusing and murderers and idolaters and everyone loving and doing falsehood.

familiar.text: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

modern.text: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

original.text: ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος.

verses.restored: I, Jesus, sent my messenger to witness these things to you for assemblies. I am root and offspring of David, bright morning star.

familiar.text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

modern.text: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”

original.text: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός, ὁ πρωϊνός.

verses.restored: And Spirit and bride say: Come. And the one hearing, let say: Come. And the thirsty one, let come; the one willing, let take water of life freely.

familiar.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

modern.text: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely. Nothing May Be Added or Removed

original.text: καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω· Ἔρχου· καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω, ὁ θέλων λαβέτω ὕδωρ ζωῆς δωρεάν.

verses.restored: I witness to everyone hearing words of prophecy of this scroll: if anyone adds to them, the Divine will add upon that one plagues written in this scroll.

familiar.text: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

modern.text: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.

original.text: Μαρτυρῶ ἐγὼ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου· ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπʼ αὐτά, ⸀ἐπιθήσει ὁ θεὸς ἐπʼ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ·

verses.restored: And if anyone takes away from words of scroll of this prophecy, the Divine will take away that one's part from tree of life and holy city, written in this scroll.

familiar.text: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

modern.text: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.

original.text: καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ταύτης, ⸀ἀφελεῖ ὁ θεὸς τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας, τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ.

verses.restored: The One witnessing these things says: Yes, I come quickly. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

familiar.text: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

modern.text: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!

original.text: Λέγει ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα· Ναί· ἔρχομαι ταχύ. Ἀμήν· ⸀ἔρχου, κύριε Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: The grace of Lord Jesus be with all.

familiar.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

modern.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.

original.text: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ⸀Ἰησοῦ μετὰ ⸀πάντων.

translation_notes: The final vision is Eden restored and expanded: river, tree of life, healing of nations, no curse.
The final invitation is open: Spirit and bride say Come; the thirsty receive freely.
Text-warning concerns this prophetic scroll and should not be used to shut down responsible textual criticism.
safety_note: Revelation ends not with fear but invitation, healing of nations, face-to-face Divine presence, and grace with all.
